source_artifact.content_excerpt:
is_protected_remote_branch in the Orchestrate script peels the refs/heads/ prefix before stripping
whitespace, and the peel is case sensitive. Four spellings of main therefore escape the protected
denylist that guards remote branch deletion. This was finding F-04 from the issue 844 code review,
accepted as a P3 residual because the current ls-remote and push encoding does not turn those
spellings into a real deletion of origin/main. It is denylist hygiene on the only destructive
capability Orchestrate has, and it should not be left to depend on an encoding accident elsewhere.

title: Orchestrate protected-reference denylist misses whitespace and case variants of refs/heads/ spellings
